newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end down,yen firmer before trade data.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end down,yen firmer before trade data.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended with losses on Tuesday, slipping on the strengthening yen against the dollar, brokers said. They said investors were sidelined ahead of Japan's May customs-cleared trade data due Wednesday and the G7 summit later this week.
The Nikkei 225 ended 87.41 points or 0.42 percent down at 20,593.66. Its September futures shed 220 to finish at 20,600.

"Trade was rather featureless apart from the fact that major exporters were weak as the yen was a bit stronger," said Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities general manager. "Cautious investors concentrated on trade in individual issues."
